title: Brand Intervention v0.2.1 Journey Population v0.3 compatibility repair
summary: The accepted Brand Intervention v0.2 regression still called population.configureProvenance, which Journey Population v0.3 intentionally no longer owns. The v0.2.1 candidate updates only the package/runtime generation identity, dependency/qualification metadata and the cohort-quality regression setup: upstream source/sampling/dedup provenance goes to BrandJourneyPopulation.configureSourceProvenance, while the explicitly unknown selection rule and local selection policies go to BrandJourneyCohortDefinition.configureSelectionProvenance. API brand.intervention/0.2 and intervention semantics are unchanged. Candidate is submitted to Autobuild and remains unaccepted pending receipt.
invariants: Population owns upstream source, sampling and deduplication provenance.
Cohort definition owns selection, inclusion/exclusion and outcome-ascertainment provenance.
The regression intentionally keeps selectionRuleId=UNSPECIFIED so the cohort-quality gate still fails for the intended reason.
COHORT_EVIDENCE_QUALITY_REVIEW remains an evidence-repair path, not tone guidance.
Patch package version is 0.2.1 while API remains brand.intervention/0.2.
No acceptance claim is valid until Autobuild emits a receipt/result on main.
procedure: Inspect receiver result/receipt; only PASS may advance accepted package status.

provenance.claim: Accepted v0.2 regression contains legacy population.configureProvenance call.
Journey Population v0.3 owns upstream provenance on population.configureSourceProvenance and local selection provenance on cohort.configureSelectionProvenance.
Immutable candidate submission containing the compatibility repair; acceptance pending.
